criteria.finding: The source prefix contains all Packet 001 identities, but the obtainable loot/crafting/progression path and WW-facing Packet 006 subset are absent; offline playability is also unproven.
All 50 Packet 001 identities have source registrations, but resource acquisitions are absent, star_grass/pale_reed/ember_thistle lack natural placement, and no client/BDS load proves them in-world.
Only four timber construction recipes exist. No resource-to-component-to-WW-equipment loop exists.
The three structure templates and generation rules exist statically, but their anchors are inert and empty; waystone activation, visit rewards, and exact terrain behavior are absent or unproven.
thorn_stalker is explicitly a base hostile shell only. Apex phases, reset/ownership/persistence, and terminal reward semantics are blocked by W1-CREATIVE-003 and W1-CREATIVE-004.
All ten Whisperwood entity runtimes intentionally omit loot. Canonical non-warehouse drop identities and numeric loot envelopes remain blocked by W1-CREATIVE-001 and W1-CREATIVE-004.
Static entity tests prove role-specific roam, flee/react, pursuit, flight, climbing, and pack components across all ten Whisperwood entities; live motion remains a Checkpoint 1 observation.
Natural spawn and generation source exists, but no authorized client/BDS run has demonstrated command-free entry and exploration. Missing acquisitions also prevent the complete intended loop.
mossfang_spear and all four whisperwood armor pieces are absent, as are the rest of the 21 WW-facing Packet 006 IDs.
Eight templates and ten total prop/structure generation paths close statically, but actual discovery and terrain fit are unproven.
The apex is not implemented and the owl_shrine anchor has no rite/reward path. Boss and loot authority tickets block completion semantics.
forest_waystone has a static structure template and inert lodestone anchor only; there is no activation handler or persisted activation stamp.
broken_wagon exists, but the approved AH map-scrap/rumor reward and transition hook are absent.
Source closure and native evidence pass, but Bedrock loading is not proven by source tests.
Ten entity definitions and bounded forest spawn rules close statically; natural initialization is unrun.
Source validator confirms named structure, feature, rule, block, and item registrations; Stable BDS registration is unrun.
The source harness starts and prints runtime-ready-g8, but exact-package Stable BDS startup is unrun.
Codex v4 migration/reopen semantics pass in Node; a Bedrock same-world restart is unrun.
Source validation is clean, but only the bounded Checkpoint 1 BDS scan can prove this criterion.
